{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Replace -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline
df['biomarker_baseline'] = df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Calculate change in biomarker: final - baseline
df['biomarker_change'] = df['biomarker_final'] - df['biomarker_baseline']

# Drop rows where baseline is missing (now NaN)
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['biomarker_baseline'])

# Check the number of patients in each arm
arm_counts = df_clean['arm'].value_counts()
print("Patient counts by arm:")
print(arm_counts)

# Check if the arms are comparable with respect to severity
print("\nSeverity distribution by arm:")
severity_by_arm = pd.crosstab(df_clean['arm'], df_clean['severity'])
print(severity_by_arm)

# Check if severity is balanced across arms
print("\nSeverity balance: is the distribution similar across arms? (Yes/No)")
severity_proportions = severity_by_arm.div(severity_by_arm.sum(axis=0), axis=1)
print(severity_proportions)"}
